## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; market shows mixed internals with Materials, Consumer Staples and Healthcare leading while Tech, Financials and Industrials lag; Leadership: Moderate (3/5 top performers across Materials/Healthcare/Cons Stpl). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strength: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -2.97% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: +6.12%) CORRECTION. Utilities/Industrials under pressure with LMT (1W: -8.34% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND and RTX (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -3.41%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, RTX (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -3.41%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Tech and Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: EL (1W: +24.42%), FCX (1W: +20.49%), NEM (1W: +16.52%), MRK (1W: +15.74%), ACN (1W: +8.10%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large-cap names (NVDA, PANW, INTC, JPM, XOM/CVX) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — watch for trend break and shorter-term rotational moves.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed to soft: AAPL (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +26.61%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.04% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -0.27% (24 stocks) — rotation within Tech; watch leadership concentration.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Tenuous: V (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +6.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +8.64%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -0.37% (20 stocks) with mixed internals; select financials showing strength but broad follow-through limited.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Constructive: MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -5.04%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +2.94% (17 stocks) — defensive/cyclical mix supporting breadth.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Value/Cyclical exposure (Materials and select Healthcare/Cons Stpl): FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +16.52% | 1M: +44.58%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to beaten-up Tech/Industrial names showing BELOW TREND like AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND given short-term momentum divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND — catalyst confirmed by guidance; FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND — momentum. BEARISH: AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND — sentiment negative; INTC (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND — continued downside risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials, Consumer Staples, Healthcare — breadth supportive (part of 6/11 positives). BEARISH: Technology, Financials, Industrials — 1W weakness and notable large-cap divergences could drive rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch for 1W turn back to positive to confirm reversal from CORRECTION (monitor 1W > 0%). AAPL: continued 1M weakness below -7% would reinforce BELOW TREND and price-on-price risk. MSFT: further 1M outperformance (> +25%) would signal continuation of leadership; AVGO: further weekly declines > -6% confirm persistent BELOW TREND pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
EL (+60): Estée Lauder EPS guidance and dividend affirmation; price confirming — EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND (sentiment confirms accumulation). BA (+65): F‑15 contract headline; price diverging — BA (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND (news positive but price not yet confirming). GILD (+80): EU approval headline; cross-ref: watch price action for confirmation (price data not shown in sample).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-60): TurboTax customer losses headline — monitor INTU price action for follow-through (price not in sample). AVGO (-50): analyst caution; AVGO (1W: -6.12% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. META (-50): legal settlement chatter; META (1W: +4.85% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY — sentiment negative but 1W bounce is a divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical style tilt. FCX (1W: +20.49% | 1M: +27.41%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +24.42% | 1M: +26.02%) ABOVE TREND and MRK (1W: +15.74% | 1M: +19.65%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (NVDA, PANW, INTC, JPM) and mixed sentiment (BA/AVGO) could keep moves rotational rather than broad-based.
